notes: Focused LongMemEval multi-evidence preservation slice mined from wide branch diagnostics.
This gate tracks count/order/temporal cases where at least one relevant document already reaches top-10 but additional same-session support documents are lost.
The current baseline preserves support-document recall while allowing the two alias-dependent magazine/cuisine misses introduced by removing hand-written rescue terminology.
A first fresh 2026-05-06 run passed quality but failed latency because query embedding p95 spiked on this 32-query slice; the rerun promoted here passed without code or dataset changes.
The 2026-05-09 baseline keeps the clean runtime approach and does not require perfect Hit@10 for cases that would require benchmark-shaped synonym aliases.
